LabelsFraction.description:
A fraction of admitted items get several labels; the rest get one.

``{count: 3, fraction: 0.2}`` means 20% of admitted items get 3 labels and the
rest get 1. Which items get 3 is decided by a hashed draw.

count.description: Labels for the items chosen by the draw.
count.title: Count

fraction.description: Share of admitted items that get `count`.
fraction.title: Fraction

LabelsFraction.title: LabelsFraction

Stage.description: One stage of a workflow: its input, the roles assigned to it, and its settings.

assign_to.description: The role, or list of roles, whose holders may claim this stage's slots.
assign_to.title: Assign To

input.description: Where the stage takes items from: an earlier stage (`annotate`), only the items whose labels agreed (`annotate.agreed`) or disagreed (`annotate.disagreed`). Omit it to take every item of the dataset.
input.title: Input

labels_per_item.description: How many different people label each admitted item: a number, `{count, fraction}`, or `all` (everyone holding the roles at admission).
labels_per_item.title: Labels Per Item

name.description: The stage name, unique in the workflow.
name.title: Name

sample.description: The fraction of arriving items admitted, by hashed draw. Default: all.
sample.title: Sample

score_against.description: An item property holding a key (such as a gold-standard answer) that each label is scored against. It changes no routing.
score_against.title: Score Against

show_prior.description: Whether labelers see earlier labels for the item. `false` makes the stage blind.
show_prior.title: Show Prior

Stage.title: Stage

description: A labeling workflow: the dataset it labels, the label task, the stages in order (each naming its input, its roles and its settings), and the final step that says where final labels come from. Stage names must be unique, an input must name an earlier stage, and every item must be able to reach a final label.

dataset.description: The dataset whose items enter the workflow.
dataset.title: Dataset

final.description: Where final labels come from: an ordered list of stages, where the first stage that labeled an item supplies its final label. `none` means the workflow produces no final labels. Default: every stage, last-listed first.
final.title: Final

label_task.description: The label task, as `name@version`, for example `image_ontology@1`.
label_task.title: Label Task

workflow.description: The workflow name, unique in the project.
workflow.title: Workflow

title: Labeling workflow config
